channel.title: European Medical Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: GLP-1RAs Not Linked to Thyroid Cancer Progression
item.description: GLP-1 receptor agonists were not associated with recurrence or progression in well differentiated thyroid cancer, supporting safe clinical use. The post GLP-1RAs Not Linked to Thyroid Cancer Progression appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Does Smoking Lower Parkinson’s Disease Risk?
item.description: A large cohort study links smoking habits to Parkinson’s disease risk and all-cause mortality, showing persistent smokers have lower PD risk but quitting improves survival. The post Does Smoking Lower Parkinson’s Disease Risk? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Emerging Immune Markers May Help Predict Melanoma Progression
item.description: LAG-3 and TIGIT expression may predict skin melanoma progression and survival. Discover how these immune markers could shape future therapies. Read more. The post Emerging Immune Markers May Help Predict Melanoma Progression appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: One in Four Miss NHS Appointments
item.description: Nearly one in four miss NHS appointments, according to a new NHS England survey of 2,000 people across the country. The post One in Four Miss NHS Appointments appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Respiratory Biologics Underprescribed in Obesity-Linked Asthma
item.description: Respiratory biologics were prescribed to few eligible adults with asthma and obesity, yet reduced exacerbations significantly. The post Respiratory Biologics Underprescribed in Obesity-Linked Asthma appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Age-Related Increase in Cervical Cancer Risk in Women Living with HIV
item.description: Cervical cancer risk increases with age in women living with HIV, with a peak at 45-49-years-old. The post Age-Related Increase in Cervical Cancer Risk in Women Living with HIV appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: The Silent Pandemic: Fighting AMR for Child Health
item.description: In the first instalment of our ‘Silent Pandemic’ series on AMR, host Catherine Glass speaks with Glenda Gray, paediatrician and infectious disease expert. The post The Silent Pandemic: Fighting AMR for Child Health appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Hand and Foot Eczema Patch Testing Yields Few Positives
item.description: Patch testing in hand and foot eczema frequently showed no allergen, yet potassium dichromate topped positive results overall here. The post Hand and Foot Eczema Patch Testing Yields Few Positives appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Mediterranean Diet Linked to Lower Adult-Onset Asthma Risk
item.description: High adherence to the Mediterranean diet was linked to a significantly lower risk of adult-onset asthma in a large Spanish cohort study. The post Mediterranean Diet Linked to Lower Adult-Onset Asthma Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: New contender enters oral weight loss drug race
item.description: The study suggests that the novel compound may offer superior glycaemic control and weight reduction compared with current GLP-1 drugs. The post New contender enters oral weight loss drug race appeared first on European Medical Journal.
